name: @mhayden/opencode-mythos-plugin
description: Unofficial OpenCode V2 provider plugin for Claude Mythos models using your ant CLI login. Not affiliated with OpenCode or Anthropic.
author: Major Hayden <major@mhtx.net>

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --banner "// Unofficial plugin. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the OpenCode project or Anthropic." --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm --packages external
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run verify:package
